sourceTitle: Rinnai N-series residential with pump SENSEI installation and operation manual (RUR199i, RUR160i, RUR199e, RUR160e), section 5.6
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not try to light the water heater, do not touch an electrical switch, and do not use a phone in the building. Leave and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off power at the breaker and shut the gas supply before any panel comes off. Gas pressure, the burner, the gas valve, venting and the control board belong to a licensed technician or the manufacturer's technical support.
displayPattern: Controller shows SS (the manual also writes SS). It is a time-based service indicator set during installation, not a lockout.
meaning: Service soon: it is time to flush the heat exchanger.
causes: The service-soon timer set in the parameter settings has run out
diySteps: SS means the heat exchanger should be flushed so scale does not damage it. The procedure is section 6.3. Hard water has to be treated or the scale comes back
To clear the code after service, press the On/Off button on the temperature controller 5 times within 5 seconds
proAdvice: If you have not flushed this model before, have the installer or a licensed technician do section 6.3 rather than clearing SS and ignoring it. The manual says the flush is what prevents scale damage.
